prompt: Review Meta's causal relationship to AI compute, networking and hyperscaler monetization.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Meta deploys AI compute to improve recommendations, engagement, advertising returns and new product monetization; shareholder benefit depends on incremental revenue and margins exceeding infrastructure, talent, financing and dilution costs.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject if AI investment does not produce durable engagement, advertising or messaging economics sufficient to offset capital spending, depreciation, debt, stock compensation and Reality Labs losses.
